origin.summary: Kemal has spent decades caring for municipal records and has learned that ordinary paperwork can preserve the memory of a city.

origin_facts.fact: Kemal has worked in the municipal archive for more than twenty years.
A flood early in his career damaged several collections.

formative_events.summary: The archive flood forced Kemal to choose which collections to rescue first.
formative_events.impact: He became careful about context, provenance, and what gets forgotten.

origin_relationships.subject: former archive director
origin_relationships.unresolved_tension: Kemal never fully agreed with the director's priorities for what should be preserved.

unresolved_origin_questions.question: Why were several flood-era catalog references never reconciled with the surviving boxes?

present_situation.summary: Kemal is training a younger archivist while preparing for a future archive relocation and a large digitization backlog.
present_situation.current_location_context: municipal archive in a stable inland city
current_relationship_context: regular contact with a neighborhood historian
current_pressures: planned archive relocation in two years
current_open_questions: how much responsibility to hand over
immediate_desires: leave the archive usable and understandable
immediate_avoidances: turning routine archive work into unnecessary drama

identity_anchors.statement: A patient custodian of public memory.
He values quiet competence more than recognition.

core_drives.drive: preserve useful context for people who come later

core_fears.fear: important context being lost while records technically survive

internal_tensions.description: Kemal knows an archive cannot remain frozen merely because he understands the old system.

long_term_questions.question: What does responsible stewardship look like when it is time to hand work to someone else?

threads.title: The Unreconciled Catalog
threads.premise: A handful of ordinary flood-era references may point to gaps in how one period of neighborhood history was cataloged, but the question can remain dormant until ordinary archive work makes it relevant.

character_relevance.why_it_matters: The thread touches Kemal's professional values without requiring him to personally investigate it.

any_of.condition: a flood-era reference becomes relevant to a chosen archive task
the trainee independently notices a catalog inconsistency

seeds.summary: A catalog card points to a ledger location that no longer matches the shelf map.

world_binding_hint.description: Prefer an existing flood-era catalog or finding aid.

allowed_usage: The inconsistent reference may be noticed during ordinary work.
forbidden_usage: Do not invent the missing ledger's contents.
Do not imply wrongdoing without evidence.
visibility_policy.reveal_ceiling: Only the mismatch between catalog metadata and current shelf location may be established.

any_of.condition: a story naturally involves relevant catalog work

seeds.summary: The trainee remembers a similar mismatch from another collection but is unsure whether it matters.

allowed_usage: The trainee may mention the memory after relevant trust/context exists.
forbidden_usage: Do not make the trainee secretly know the answer.
Do not force Kemal to pursue the clue.
visibility_policy.reveal_ceiling: Only a possible pattern of catalog mismatches may be suggested.

all_of.condition: the trainee has participated in at least one relevant archive task

milestones.summary: Kemal or the trainee may establish why a subset of flood-era references were moved or renumbered.

any_of.condition: at least one mismatch has been legitimately discovered

possible_consequences: A small neighborhood-history gap may become clearer.
Responsibility for follow-up may shift to the trainee.

branches.trigger: The mismatch becomes relevant to a chosen story.

paths.description: Kemal investigates directly as part of normal archive work.
The trainee takes the lead while Kemal advises.
They record the inconsistency and leave it dormant for later.

possible_payoffs.description: A fuller but modest understanding of one neighborhood collection and a stronger handoff between Kemal and the trainee.

proposed_bindings.description: Bind to an existing catalog/finding-aid entity if one exists in the simulated archive.
placement_constraints: must remain inside the known municipal archive context

proposed_bindings.description: Bind to the already-defined younger archivist trainee.
placement_constraints: must not create a replacement trainee NPC

integration_rules: Saga elements must appear to belong to the archive independently of Kemal.
Do not create world entities only to force Saga progression.
